package cacher

import "testing"

func TestBehavior(t *testing.T) {
	w := &watchCache{}
	if err := w.processEvent(Event{Type: "ADDED", Key: "secrets/default/one", Object: map[string]interface{}{"metadata": map[string]interface{}{"name": "one", "namespace": "default"}}}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if w.seen != 1 || w.last != "secrets/default/one" || len(w.values) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("changed cache write: %+v", w)
	}
}
